scope: Bounded read-only research of eight works in the 24 unresolved complete-person-facts queue. Search discovery is distinguished from an opened original body. No application, private relationship, image, stage, date or frozen checklist mutation.

limitations: This is not an exhaustive recheck of all 24 works or all 155 categories.
BABYMONSTER and ILLIT were not selected because the current 24-work queue does not include them; no completed batch was reimported.

Original broadcast/label pages frequently identify only the group. A named album edition, group roster, video length or fan line distribution does not establish each member's recording or exact MV appearance.
YouTube fetch throttling and a fan-club timeout were recorded without bypass, repeated fetching or invented viewing claims.
Some attempted searches rediscovered old routes; those are explicitly not counted as new evidence.

additionalPeerReview.assessment: Original named interview supports a narrow five-person role note: SEUNGJOO Japanese recording; DOHEE harmony aligned with KANNY rap; KANNY rap attributed by DOHEE; HITOMI and MEI Japanese lyric translation and pronunciation guidance. It does not justify a complete seven-member recording/MV cast inferred from the interview roster. Separate MV self-reports exist for MEI/HITOMI, and SOHA names a scene with KANNY, but those need explicit role wording rather than a merged cast assertion.
additionalPeerReview.parentDisposition: Parent verified existing private seven-person relations and will consider only a collapsed topic note with the five narrow roles, no new public credit/member IDs/images and no claimed closure of the 155-item queue.

stopReason: Bounded new first-party/original-body routes for the selected works did not provide an adoptable new individual role. Preserve unresolved facts and existing increments; do not repeat restricted videos or identical failed searches to manufacture a delta.
